text:
emma (support): Heads-up: multiple customers reporting increased 5xx and timeouts for hosted API since the midday deploy in us-east. Fresh escalation from AcmeCorp with traces showing gateway 502/504.

jordan (oncall): I'm seeing alert noise too — 5xx rate jumped ~3x around 12:05 UTC for /v1/generate. Region: us-east-1.

liam (sre): Can you paste a sample failing request/trace id? Also whether it's generative endpoints only or embeddings as well.

emma (support): AcmeCorp trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d. They ran a load test hitting streaming generate. Error was 502 gateway then 504 on retry. Not seeing embedding failures in their repro.

maria (platform): Noted. Deploy-bot: which release went live at 12:00?

deploy-bot: release-2026.03.17-rolling started by nick at 11:58 UTC, completed canary at 12:02 UTC, promoted to 60% at 12:04 UTC.

nick (deploy): That release included the new routing flag use_prefetch_router=true and a batching window change (BATCH_WINDOW_MS: 50 -> 5).

liam (sre): BATCH_WINDOW_MS drop to 5ms could starve batching heuristics and increase concurrency to upstream routers. If upstreams throttle we might see transient 5xx. Maria, can we check router queue saturation?

maria (platform): Looking at router metrics now — queue length spiked at canary promote, CPU not saturated but connection spikes and upstream timeouts increased. I see a config mismatch: some nodes rolled an env var ROUTER_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false despite flag true. That explains inconsistent behaviour across pool.

jordan (oncall): Repro steps from support: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"x"}' --header 'Accept: text/event-stream' then stream stalls and eventually gateway 504.

liam (sre): Can we get gateway logs for trace-0a1b2c3d?

maria (platform): Pasted relevant snippet: ```
[12:05:12] gateway: upstream_timeout route=generate backend=router-07 status=504 trace=trace-0a1b2c3d
[12:05:12] router-07: backend_conn_reset to model-host-4 during KV fetch
[12:05:12] router-02: prefetched=false batch_send_delay=5ms
```

emma (support): Customer also reports spike in billing errors for requests that returned 502 — invoices show token counts but no successful responses. They want credits.

nick (deploy): Immediate remediation plan: 1) Pause rollout and revert BATCH_WINDOW_MS to 50ms on the promoted pool. 2) Rollback use_prefetch_router flag to previous value across all nodes for parity. 3) Open a postmortem-runbook to fix deploy automation that left env var mismatch.

jordan (oncall): I'll coordinate the rollback. Liam, can you validate traffic routing once rollback is applied and watch 5xx rate?

liam (sre): On it. I'll also add a short-term circuit: if gateway upstream timeout rate > 1% for 2m, route to stable model variant without prefetch.

maria (platform): Kicking a rollback now for promoted pool. Patch rolling back BATCH_WINDOW_MS and setting ROUTER_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false in the config map. ETA ~ 6 minutes.

deploy-bot: rollback-2026.03.17 initiated by nick at 12:20 UTC, targeting nodes in us-east promoted pool.

emma (support): Informing AcmeCorp support contact and offering temporary credits for failed requests.

jordan (oncall): 12:26 UTC — early signals look good, 5xx rate trending down. Liam, any residual errors?

liam (sre): 12:28 UTC — 5xx back to baseline, router queue normalized. I see a few leftover timeouts from inflight requests; those should drain.

maria (platform): Post-rollback checklist: fix deploy pipeline so env var state is enforced during canary promotion; add validation step comparing config map to expected flag state.

nick (deploy): Will open a hotfix PR to the deploy orchestrator and schedule an infra postmortem. Also adding a short runbook entry about billing credits flow when we rollback mid-deploy.

emma (support): Customer notified, they appreciated the quick rollback. Keeping thread open until billing credits processed.

liam (sre): Action items summary: 1) Confirm deploy pipeline fix (nick). 2) Add route circuit breaker (jordan). 3) Postmortem and customer credit reconciliation (emma).

maria (platform): Logging follow-up: saving trace-0a1b2c3d and related router logs under /incidents/4498765432 for postmortem.

emma (support): Closing loop — AcmeCorp accepted credit and service looks stable. We'll file the incident report tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
